test.query: SELECT k, groupArray(2)(number) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(number % 15000) AS k, number FROM numbers_mt(200000000)) GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, groupArray(4)(number) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(number % 16000) AS k, number FROM numbers_mt(200000000)) GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, uniqExact(x) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(number % 15000) AS k, number % 3 AS x FROM numbers_mt(150000000)) GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, any(s) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(number % 16000) AS k, toString(number) AS s FROM numbers_mt(100000000)) GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, argMax(toString(number), number) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(number % 16000) AS k, number FROM numbers_mt(50000000)) GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, groupBitmap(number % 1000) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(number % 16000) AS k, number FROM numbers_mt(100000000)) GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
